description: Fact table for the expanded latent-intermediate panel (C40). Every entity is one of the 70 target words the component lens artifact covers. A clue identifies its entity without naming it. Answers list accepted continuation forms; an item is correct if the greedy continuation begins with any form. A clue's 'skip' lists relations it must not be used with (e.g. a landmark inside the capital city). 'forbid' lists words that must not appear in a prompt using that entity (names, demonyms, language adjectives). Clues are new: none is copied from the upstream probe-swap set or from data/heldout/concept-use.json. Authored 2026-09-30, before any model call on these prompts.
